findings.issue: Competing dispatcher ownership breaks A-to-B installation and later uninstall.
findings.disposition: Fixed root-owned dispatcher authority and separate per-home hook ownership; upgrade/uninstall counterexamples verified.

findings.issue: Machine native dispatcher rejects supported legacy manual pins.
findings.disposition: Fixed manual exact-pin compatibility while retaining strict automatic/development interface admission.

findings.issue: Native dispatch changes nested manual caller working directory.
findings.disposition: Fixed manual dispatch to preserve caller cwd and relative arguments.

findings.issue: User installation silently permits duplicate active legacy project callbacks.
findings.disposition: Fixed exact attested group removal followed by rejection of remaining unknown executable callbacks, including inactive receipts.

findings.issue: Legacy disable permits a live worker to keep publishing fresh source changes.
findings.disposition: Fixed legacy active-state fencing so disabled/uninstalled live workers stop publication.

findings.issue: Automatic generation inherits shared capture limits instead of selected-local defaults.
findings.disposition: Fixed automatic generation to use whole selected-local policy and bounded defaults throughout publication.

findings.issue: Root-journal recovery rewrites home hooks before acquiring the home lock.
findings.disposition: Fixed recovery lease acquisition and post-acquisition resource rediscovery with explicit retry before unheld-resource writes.

findings.issue: An explicitly bound child prevents parent reconciliation and publication.
findings.disposition: Fixed explicitly bound child publication independently, retaining actual external ancestry in portable v6 facts.

findings.issue: Terminating native dispatch leaves the selected manual CLI process alive.
findings.disposition: Fixed POSIX dispatch with exec so cancellation owns the selected process and preserves exit status.

findings.issue: PowerShell native routing bypasses existing lossless transport and timeout.
findings.disposition: Fixed PowerShell native routing to reuse lossless argument/handle transport and advisory timeout.

findings.issue: Windows missing-launcher repair stores inconsistent executable ownership hashes.
findings.disposition: Fixed: stable launcher repair records actual installed hashes; native Windows repair passed within partial platform evidence.

findings.issue: Native user installation and migration interruption/recovery lack a direct acceptance oracle.
findings.disposition: Added actual root/home journal durable-prefix interruption, recovery and conflict oracles with pending-state preservation.

findings.issue: Native Windows binding feedback uses a non-executable POSIX-quoted command.
findings.disposition: Fixed platform-aware Windows binding command syntax and quoting.

findings.issue: User installation accepts an incompatible native executable and breaks the shared dispatcher.
findings.disposition: Fixed native format/platform/protocol/build identity admission before installer writes.

findings.issue: Alleged callback process-cwd routing loss conflates process cwd with declared native session cwd.
findings.disposition: Refuted: process cwd differs from declared native session cwd; contract requires rejection of contradictory authoritative context. Original reported severity8 is not a demonstrated defect.

findings.issue: Retaining mutable development output can accept incomplete bytes changed after selection.
findings.disposition: Fixed retention with stable copied-byte metadata/digest/native validation, rejecting incomplete or changed source bytes.

findings.issue: Planning migration before interrupted-install recovery can reject resume or leave restored legacy callbacks active.
findings.disposition: Fixed recovery before fresh migration planning; discovered during tester correction validation, not review first pass.

findings.issue: External-parent child publication falsely declares complete group coverage and a clean session.
findings.disposition: Fixed external-parent group completeness and clean wording while preserving per-owner analysis and exact cached summaries.

findings.issue: CLI history fixture rejects valid external-parent ancestry as malformed.
findings.disposition: Fixed: Transfer to preserved external ancestry and retain blank/whitespace/padded identity rejection with nonmutation.

findings.issue: Scan and migration fixtures require capture machine state in shared-only configuration.
findings.disposition: Fixed: Accept shared-only read/manual configuration and retain selected-local malformed-type nonmutation oracles.

findings.issue: Reconciliation fixture treats an explicitly bound child on another ticket as a parent conflict.
findings.disposition: Fixed: create genuine source-parent inherited conflict through actual interfaces, retain explicit independent-child success, exact facts and historical failure diagnostics.

findings.issue: PowerShell native transport inherits Win32 cwd instead of the caller filesystem location.
findings.disposition: Fixed: use caller filesystem ProviderPath for native child cwd; actual Windows cwd/argument cases passed.

findings.issue: Windows setup discards successful native stderr diagnostics.
findings.disposition: Fixed: forward successful UTF8 setup diagnostics to stderr; actual Windows both-stream case passed.

findings.issue: Windows InitConfig emits a scaffold rejected by canonical native completion.
findings.disposition: Fixed: emit canonical minimal bootstrap scaffold; isolated actual Windows completion passed.

findings.issue: Windows fixtures mutate and delete retained read-only executables without clearing the read-only attribute.
findings.disposition: Fixed: permit owned read-only cleanup/tamper while preserving genuine process-lock failures.

findings.issue: The adopted Windows advisory fixture replaces an immutable exact-pin leaf without explicit repair.
findings.disposition: Fixed: use explicit Force only for intentional fixture-owned binary replacement.

findings.issue: The Windows binding fixture uses YAML escaping outside the supported bootstrap subset.
findings.disposition: Fixed: encode the apostrophe path within the supported quoted slash-path profile.

findings.issue: The local Windows protocol2 fixture can fail reading its PE input through DrvFS.
findings.disposition: Accepted Windows-only limit: CI/verification withdrawn by explicit user instruction; follow-up is the user's planned Windows support removal. No full Windows pass claimed.
